C0782.title: Xinference Supply Chain Poisoning Incident
C0782.summary: In April 2026, the open-source AI model deployment tool Xinference was found to have been compromised in a supply chain poisoning attack. Attackers gained access to its PyPI repository publishing permissions and embedded multi-layer Base64-encoded malicious code in the initialization files of versions 2.6.0, 2.6.1, and 2.6.2. Simply installing or importing the tool triggered automatic execution of
